# Source and differences

Independent expected nodes follow docs/zmk/behaviors.md §3.1–3.4 at ZMK v0.3.0 (edf5c0814fd3ea202e43aad2d68fd32e882a518c). Names/actions are product examples. Negative cells use parenthesized expressions per docs/zmk/keymap.md §3; initial <-1> expectation was rejected by ZMK review before completion. Five-types golden contains all five supported kinds.
